question: Which taxi neighborhoods overlap downtown Manhattan around the Financial District and Tribeca, roughly inside longitude -74.02 to -73.97 and latitude 40.70 to 40.76? Show their names and shapes.
sql: SELECT zone, borough, ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS shape FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough = 'Manhattan' AND geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.70, -73.97, 40.76) AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.70, -73.97, 40.76))

question: What is the overall rectangular bounding box that encloses all of the Brooklyn taxi zones?
sql: SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Envelope(ST_Union_Agg(geometry))) AS brooklyn_bbox_geojson, ST_AsText(ST_Extent(geometry)) AS brooklyn_extent_box2d FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE borough = 'Brooklyn'

question: How many taxi trips in January 2024 started and ended entirely inside the JFK and southern Queens rectangle between longitude -73.85 to -73.75 and latitude 40.60 to 40.69?
sql: WITH env AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.85, 40.60, -73.75, 40.69) AS geom) SELECT COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON pu.location_id = t.PULocationID JOIN nyc_taxi_zones dl ON dl.location_id = t.DOLocationID CROSS JOIN env WHERE pu.geometry && env.geom AND dl.geometry && env.geom AND ST_CoveredBy(pu.geometry, env.geom) AND ST_CoveredBy(dl.geometry, env.geom) AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01'

question: Which taxi zones intersect the Central Park rectangle from longitude -73.98 to -73.949 and latitude 40.764 to 40.80, and how big is each zone and its overlap in square kilometers?
sql: SELECT zone, borough, ST_Area(ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true))/1000000 AS area_sq_km, ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_Intersection(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.98, 40.764, -73.949, 40.80)), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true))/1000000 AS overlap_sq_km FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.98, 40.764, -73.949, 40.80) ORDER BY overlap_sq_km DESC

question: How many trips went from a Manhattan pickup inside the Manhattan box longitude -74.02 to -73.96 latitude 40.70 to 40.88 to a Queens dropoff inside the Queens box longitude -73.96 to -73.70 latitude 40.68 to 40.80, and what was the average fare and distance?
sql: WITH manhattan_env AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.02, 40.70, -73.96, 40.88) AS geom), queens_env AS (SELECT ST_MakeEnvelope(-73.96, 40.68, -73.70, 40.80) AS geom) SELECT COUNT(*) AS cross_borough_trips, AVG(t.total_amount) AS avg_total, AVG(t.trip_distance) AS avg_distance FROM nyc_taxi_trips t JOIN nyc_taxi_zones pu ON pu.location_id = t.PULocationID JOIN nyc_taxi_zones dl ON dl.location_id = t.DOLocationID CROSS JOIN manhattan_env CROSS JOIN queens_env WHERE pu.geometry && manhattan_env.geom AND dl.geometry && queens_env.geom AND ST_Intersects(pu.geometry, manhattan_env.geom) AND ST_Intersects(dl.geometry, queens_env.geom) AND pu.borough = 'Manhattan' AND dl.borough = 'Queens'

question: Which taxi zones have the smallest envelope rectangles inside the greater New York City bounding box, and how large are those envelopes in square kilometers?
sql: SELECT zone, borough, ST_Area(ST_Transform(ST_Envelope(geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true))/1000000 AS envelope_area_sqkm FROM nyc_taxi_zones WHERE geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-74.256, 40.496, -73.70, 40.916) ORDER BY envelope_area_sqkm ASC LIMIT 10
